# Pro Visuals Program — Test Strategy

**Generated by:** `/plan-eng-review`
**Date:** 2026-07-23
**Branch reviewed:** `main`
**Base commit:** `fe8e677`
**Parent plan:** [`2026-07-23-pro-visuals-master-plan.md`](2026-07-23-pro-visuals-master-plan.md)
**Design specification:** [`../specs/2026-07-23-pro-visuals-program-design.md`](../specs/2026-07-23-pro-visuals-program-design.md)

This is the program-level test input for every `SP-*` sub-plan and for later `/qa` runs. A sub-plan copies
the paths it owns, replaces planned filenames with exact current files, and does not weaken a program gate.

## 1. Test framework and execution environments

The repository uses Node’s built-in test runner:

```text
npm test
  -> node --test "test/*.test.js" "test/*.test.mjs"
```

The existing suite has 301 passing tests at the reviewed base. New pure/contract tests stay in this runner.
Renderer integration uses Electron because DOM mocks cannot prove WebGL compilation, resource cleanup,
post-processing output, or packaged asset delivery.

| Environment | Required checks | Allowed outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Any supported Node environment | Unit, schema, contract, security, parity, CLI tests | Must pass |
| Electron with WebGL, including normal CI when available | Synthetic renderer smoke and fixed capture | Must pass or emit explicit capability failure |
| Named Windows GPU benchmark machine | Full real-course visual/performance/resource suites | Must run and pass for milestone/release |
| Packaged Windows application | Offline art assets, fallback, startup, one synthetic frame | Must run and pass for M2 |

A skipped GPU-backed release suite is a failed release gate. A machine that genuinely lacks WebGL may emit a
capability artifact during ordinary CI, but that artifact cannot satisfy M1 or M2.

## 2. Program execution diagram

```text
SERVER / PREPARATION                                   CLIENT / RENDERER

[load base course]
  |
  +-- invalid/no holes ------------------------------> [typed load error; prior course remains]
  |
  v
[derive courseId]
  +-- OSM identity
  +-- legacy alias + origin tolerance
  +-- collision/mismatch ----------------------------> [automatic tier; no wrong pack]
  |
  v
[resolve HD against BASE fingerprint]
  |
  v
[locate curated pack]
  +-- absent ----------------------------------------> [automatic presentation]
  +-- invalid/unsupported/oversized -----------------> [one diagnostic + automatic fallback]
  +-- valid -----------------------------------------> [normalized curated presentation]
  |
  v
[compile gameplay overlays once]
  +-- surfaces/pins
  +-- ordered terrain patches
  +-- invalid feature -------------------------------> [pack/feature policy; no partial mutation]
  |
  v
[build immutable ResolvedCoursePackage]
  +-- courseRevision
  +-- contentRevision
  +-- asset allowlist
  +-- typed diagnostics
  |
  +-- unexpected preparation failure ---------------> [abort; prior course remains]
  |
  v
[atomic commit + game.setCourse]
  |
  v
[/api/course-geometry] ------------------------------> [loadGeometry generation N]
[/api/course-art/:key] ------------------------------>   |
                                                         +-- generation N superseded
                                                         |     -> abort/ignore/dispose
                                                         |
                                                         +-- HD partial failure
                                                         |     -> procedural visual fallback
                                                         |
                                                         v
                                                   [CourseBuildContext N]
                                                         |
                              +--------------------------+--------------------------+
                              |                          |                          |
                        [WorldContext]             [SurfaceSystem]        [Vegetation/Landmarks]
                              |                          |                          |
                              +--------------------------+--------------------------+
                                                         |
                                                         v
                                                  [GolfScene commit]
                                                         |
                                                         v
                                              [matching readiness ack]
                                                         |
                                                         v
                                                  [shots unlocked]
```

Every conditional branch above requires a test. The renderer must never acknowledge a different revision
from the one it displays.

## 3. Codepath coverage requirements

Legend:

- `★★★` behavior + edge + error paths.
- `★★` happy path plus one boundary.
- `→E2E` requires a real server/Electron boundary.
- `→PACKAGE` requires the built application.
- `PLANNED` means the sub-plan must create the named test before its phase can exit.

### 3.1 Identity, validation, and activation

```text
[+] lib/course-identity.js
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] OSM way/relation identity is stable
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] renamed course with same OSM identity still matches
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] same name at different origin does not match
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] legacy alias requires origin tolerance
  `-- [★★★ PLANNED] malformed identity selects no curated pack
      -> test/course-identity.test.js

[+] base cache + HD identity
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] same-name/different-OSM courses use different cache entries
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] cache hit verifies requested source identity
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] legacy slug cache migrates only after geographic verification
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] fingerprint v2 ignores display-name changes
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] fingerprint v1 manifest remains readable
  `-- [★★★ PLANNED] unsupported fingerprint version diagnoses/falls back
      -> test/course-cache-identity.test.js + test/hd-fingerprint.test.mjs

[+] generated course-art validator
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] valid v1 manifest
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] unsupported version/unknown field
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] traversal/absolute path
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] NaN/infinity/out-of-envelope coordinates
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] maximum count/bytes/dimensions
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] terrain-feature section is rejected until SP-05 capability exists
  `-- [★★★ PLANNED] generated validator is current
      -> test/course-art-pack-schema.test.js

[+] ResolvedCoursePackage prepare/commit
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] base fingerprint computed before overlays
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] missing pack commits automatic package
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] invalid pack commits automatic fallback with one diagnostic
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] valid pack changes contentRevision, not base fingerprint
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] same-name asset byte change updates contentRevision
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] gameplay overlay changes contentRevision and both consumers
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] unexpected prepare error keeps previous course/revision
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] slow request A cannot commit after later fast request B
  `-- [★★★ PLANNED] commit mutates active state exactly once
      -> test/course-activation.test.js
```

### 3.2 Asset gateway and ownership

```text
[+] GET/HEAD /api/course-art/:contentRevision/:assetKey        [→E2E]
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] exact active key returns allowlisted MIME
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] HEAD returns metadata without body
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] ETag/contentRevision supports 304
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] wrong/stale revision is rejected
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] unknown/inactive key returns 404
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] encoded traversal/absolute path returns 400/404
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] disallowed type or oversized file is rejected
  `-- [★★★ PLANNED] error body never contains an absolute machine path
      -> test/course-art-http.test.js

[+] public/render/course-assets.js
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] duplicate acquire shares one resource
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] first release retains shared resource
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] final release disposes texture/model once
  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] failed load removes cache entry and reports typed error
  `-- [★★★ PLANNED] stale generation releases immediately
      -> test/course-assets.test.mjs + Electron resource smoke
```

[+] packaged application                                         [→PACKAGE]

  +-- [★★★ PLANNED] authoring references/intermediates are absent

Planned-branch coverage is **complete by requirement**: every branch above has a named test destination.
Implementation coverage remains unclaimed until the owning phase lands and the tests execute.

## 4. Failure-mode audit

| Production failure | Test required | Error handling | User experience |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wrong same-name course gets Chambers pack | Identity collision test | Reject match | Automatic course, no leaked content |
| Wrong same-name base cache is returned | Cache identity test | Reject/migrate only verified cache | Correct course loads or clear retry error |
| Slow earlier server load finishes after latest choice | Delayed A/B activation test | Latest-only commit generation | Latest selected course stays active |
| Valid course activation fails halfway | Prepare/commit injection test | Keep previous package | Previous course remains playable; retry message |
| Generated validator is stale | Regeneration diff test | Build/test failure | Never reaches users |
| Traversal key requests local file | HTTP security tests | Reject before filesystem read | Generic 400/404 |
| Curated asset is missing | Asset load test | Disable only referencing feature | Concise warning; course stays playable |
| Browser reuses old bytes for same asset key | Revision URL/content hash test | New URL + revision mismatch rejection | Updated art appears, never cross-course |
| Older geometry load completes last | Delayed race test | Revision check + disposal | Latest selected course remains visible |
| Older readiness ack arrives | Revision/nonce test | Reject ack | Shots unlock only for displayed package |
| Feature compiler differs from renderer | Shared-patch parity test | No second compiler permitted | No floating/sinking |
| Curated evidence contaminates M1 | Pack-disabled manifest test | Harness asserts tier | M1 score remains honest |
| Renderer module throws | Module isolation/core-failure tests | Optional isolate; core abort | Feature warning or previous scene |
| GPU resources grow each switch | Repeated A/B load test | Handle release + module dispose | No eventual slowdown/crash |
| Software renderer reports misleading FPS | Capability probe test | Mark non-qualifying | Release cannot pass on invalid numbers |
| Pack omitted from installer | Package contents/offline smoke | Package gate fails | Never ships broken installer |

With these requirements applied, no critical path is both silent and uncovered.

## 5. Visual acceptance matrix

| Frame | Chambers automatic | Chambers curated | Sawgrass automatic | St Andrews automatic |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Address/play | Required | Required | Required | Required |
| Close green | Required | Required | Required | Required |
| Close bunker | Required | Required | Required | Required |
| Mid-flight/landing | Required | Required | Required | Required |
| Elevated hole overview | Required | Required | Required | Required |
| High course overview | Required | Required | Required | Required |
| Horizon/world edge | Generic edge gate | Coast identity gate | No phantom coast | No phantom coast |
| UI | Functional baseline | Professional HUD gate | Regression | Regression |

Pixel diffs detect unexpected change. Human review judges realism and course identity. A phase may claim only
the viewing bands and frames named in its sub-plan.

## 6. Performance protocol

SP-00 records the exact machine before setting numeric content caps. Every performance run must include:

- GPU, driver, CPU, RAM, OS, Electron, Chromium, Node, resolution, pixel ratio, and quality profile.
- A shader/asset warm-up pass excluded from results.
- The committed camera route for at least 60 seconds.
- Average, median, 1% low, and worst hitch from CPU frame intervals.
- GPU time only when a supported timer query reports valid, non-disjoint samples.
- Draw calls, triangles, active geometries/textures/programs, curated resident bytes, vegetation instances,
  and reflection passes.
- Five alternating Chambers/Sawgrass loads followed by a settled resource baseline comparison.

Three.js may retain reusable internal resources. The leak assertion is “no monotonic growth after steady
state,” not “renderer.info becomes zero.”

## 7. Commands expected by the completed program

```text
npm test
npm run visual:smoke
npm run visual:capture -- --suite baseline --packs disabled
npm run visual:capture -- --suite chambers-curated
npm run visual:perf -- --suite release
npm run pack
npm run package:smoke
```

The exact scripts are introduced by SP-00, SP-07a/07b, and SP-09b. Until they exist, a sub-plan must say
“planned command” rather than claiming the check ran.
